rootCause.currentGatewayObservation: The authenticated gateway run below passed all 55 assertions; no provider.auth 403, 429/529, or resource-budget denial was observed in the run summary.

securityEvidence.localBoundary: OpenCode plugin execute.before hook; thrown deny occurs before tool execution according to the OpenCode plugin runtime contract.
securityEvidence.canaryTests: src/tool-authority.test.mjs and adapter hook tests call the registered boundary before a canary executor and assert zero invocation for shell, edit/write, subagent/task, execute/code, question, web and unknown tools; orchestrator has the same rule. Worker isolation and ambiguous/missing control-plane metadata fail-closed cases are covered.
securityEvidence.gatewayScope: The gateway E2E proves the plugin was loaded and the real orchestration/follow-up/TUI path completed. It did not ask a live model to attempt a forbidden critic/orchestrator tool call; the explicit zero-executor canaries are deterministic local hook tests.

limitations: Provider quota reset times and remaining quota are unavailable; Issue #3 uses a local 15-minute heuristic window, not a provider reset claim.

The evaluator tool boundary depends on OpenCode 2.0.11 execute.before behavior and control-plane session metadata; unknown internal state fails closed.
